“Migration will disrupt our operations.”

Our migration team has moved more than 30 fleets without a single day of stopped trading. Most cutovers complete in four to six weeks, with your crew ashore working as normal while we handle the technical lift.

"From a practical point of view, the migration was quite straightforward. We felt supported throughout the entire process—the overall feeling was that we were never left on our own."
- D'Amico International Shipping

02

“Our team is used to Outlook and will resist the change.”

The interface is deliberately familiar — folders, threads, keyboard shortcuts. Guided onboarding gets operators comfortable within days, not quarters, and adoption is typically above 90% in the first month.

"When we first implemented Sedna, the team's reaction was overwhelmingly positive. Everyone was excited to finally move to a more modern solution that would enhance their productivity." - Hafnia

03

“We'll lose important historical data.”

Nothing is left behind. Your full correspondence history is imported and searchable at speeds legacy archives can't reach — 0.6 seconds across millions of messages, including decade-old PST files.

"Stream distils thousands of messages down to only the critical ones. Instant search is invaluable for looking through older messages." - Sture Freudenreich, Head of IT, Norden
